comparator.sourceNotes: Coherent 2024-entry cohort: B1 in the adopted 2024–25 OER, B2 in the adopted 2025–26 OER, and pre-September-2025 programme B3 in the adopted 2026–27 OER. The 2026–27 reformed B1/B2 cannot be combined with this older B3. Three 60 EC years total 180 EC: 124 compulsory, 40 restricted choice, 16 genuine open electives. B2 selects one period-2 theme (Emotion) and one period-3 theme (Development of Pro- and Antisocial Behaviour), plus the permitted 4 EC B3 elective Consciousness and Perception in B2 period 4. B3 selects Brain & Cognition, its required matching 6 EC domain course and a second 6 EC domain course, 4 EC applied methods, three distinct 4 EC domain electives, 4 EC ethics, 16 EC open space and 12 EC thesis. The B2 elective is not repeated in B3. These are permitted official-order examples, not an individual entitlement or a promised future entrant timetable. Old Dutch tables print the Development & Mental Health practical PSB2DH10EB as 4 EC, conflicting with the year total; the current Dutch transition table explicitly assigns 1 EC, as does the same-year 2025 English table. Use that explicit 1 EC evidence, not arithmetic inference. The prospective third-year page is indicative, totals 60.5 EC and prints career orientation as 0.5 EC; adopted OER has 60 EC and Me & My Career 2 at 0 EC. Hidden metadata and visible annual/cohort headings were checked for all four editions. B1 includes 1 EC for 24 participant hours or an approved replacement, inside its 60 EC. RADAr NL is separately mandatory at 0 EC. For B1 in 2024–25, exemption was possible only on an equivalent university language test; the current 2026–27 rule permits no exemption. Do not apply the newer restriction retrospectively; B2 Me & My Career 1 is 1 EC, B3 Me & My Career 2 is 0 EC. Current B2 entry requires positive or held BSA, B3 positive BSA; normal BSA threshold 42 EC. Statistics 2, Data Analysis and Psychometrics require Statistics 1; the latter two assume Statistics 2 knowledge. RP2 requires Statistics 1, Methods and Research Practicum 1, with Statistics 2 assumed. Ethics requires 90 EC psychology. Applied methods requires Statistics 1 and assumes Statistics 2/Psychometrics. Thesis requires 119 EC including Statistics 2, RP2 and full B1 60 EC including participant hours; Data Analysis, Psychometrics and Applied Methods assumed. Thesis normally follows selected domain; another domain needs Board permission. Exchange starts in B3 with full B1 including participation obtained six months before departure. Timely registration and course capacities apply. For B2 in 2025–26, positive BSA is required subject to documented personal-circumstance/held-decision exceptions. Conversational Skills assumes the Free Attitude Interview element of prior Professional Skills. RP2 also assumes the corresponding core theme and must use the variant corresponding to the first-semester theme, here Emotion. These B2-year conditions are preserved separately from the newer 2026–27 entry wording.

alternatives.concept: A sustained psychological and cognitive-science curriculum connects brain and behaviour, social psychology, perception, development, psychopathology and assessment. Quantitative and qualitative research and systematic review support those subjects; philosophy, sociology and rhetoric add context. Its 82.5 EC of psychology/cognitive content plus 15 EC of psychology statistics and evidence synthesis give a substantive related response, with fewer successive supervised experiments, professional-skills practica, dedicated psychometrics and no required independent psychology thesis.

alternatives.labelRationale: 82.5 EC of psychology/cognition plus 15 EC psychology quantitative and evidence-synthesis courses sustain the broad label. Complementary philosophy, rhetoric and sociology are not counted as experimental psychology.

alternatives.concept: Psychology, organisational behaviour, leadership and social influence form an applied direction. Social, abnormal, developmental and assessment psychology supply 45 EC of psychological content, with 7.5 EC organisational psychology and a 30 EC general, psychological and qualitative methods/evidence-synthesis sequence. Leadership, negotiation, diversity and communication add a distinct workplace and community emphasis. This is a related interdisciplinary route, with limited dedicated experimental and professional psychology training.

alternatives.labelRationale: Psychology, sociology, leadership and communication appear throughout the completed schedule, so a combined label describes it more accurately than organisational psychology alone.
alternatives.distinctnessRationale: Eight courses, 60 EC per route, differ. The primary retains neurobiology, higher cognition, perception, psycholinguistics and health psychology; the social route instead sustains organisational psychology, leadership, negotiation, diversity and communication across several years. The difference is a sustained change of disciplinary contribution, not a numerical quota. Shared clinical and developmental courses do not establish a third clinical specialisation.

notes.text: UCR sustains related psychology and cognitive science or social and organisational study, with general and psychological methods. Radboud has a denser dedicated psychology sequence, successive supervised research projects, professional-skills practica, psychometrics and a 12 EC domain thesis. UCR courses do not confer this psychology degree, clinical registration, professional qualification or automatic master admission.

audience.programmeDescription: Radboud Psychology studies human thoughts, feelings and behaviour through brain and cognition, development and mental health, and behaviour and environment. Research methods, academic and professional skills and a domain thesis are integral to the degree.
audience.comparisonExplanation: The closest UCR programme sustains psychology and cognitive science, supported by quantitative and qualitative methods, evidence synthesis and conceptual study. The second gives greater weight to organisational behaviour, leadership, diversity and communication. Both offer substantial related study while leaving gaps in dedicated psychology research projects, professional practice, psychometrics and the required independent thesis. A separate clinical programme is not shown because its psychological core repeated the closest match.

curriculum.limitation: The complete 180 EC contains 124 EC compulsory components, 40 EC restricted choices and 16 EC genuine open electives. B2 includes one theme in period 2 and one in period 3, plus one 4 EC B3 elective; that elective is not repeated in B3. B3 includes two 6 EC domain courses, three 4 EC domain electives, domain methods, ethics and a 12 EC thesis. The Development & Mental Health practical is 1 EC, explicitly confirmed by the current transition table despite an old Dutch 4 EC misprint. B1 participant hours carry 1 EC within 60; RADAr NL and B3 career orientation are mandatory without credit. B2 and B3 entry require the applicable BSA; ethics requires 90 EC psychology. The thesis requires 119 EC including Statistics 2, RP2 and full B1, with further methods knowledge assumed. Annual offerings, registration and capacities apply. This is a reconstructed completed cohort, not a promised future entrant schedule. In this cohort’s first year, RADAr exemption could be based only on an equivalent university language test; the current no-exemption rule is not applied retrospectively. In B2, RP2 follows the selected first-semester Emotion theme and Conversational Skills assumes prior interview preparation.
